mode: engine only, no model harness (the skills a model runs on top are out of the picture)
door: memoose --json -d adebench recall <query> -n 10 (routed mode: entities, facts as triples, chunk summaries), plus the session's standing context
results: -n 10 (adapter's choice; Memoose's default not stated), no relevance threshold, no cut
embeddings: fastembed, local (model and dimensions not stated)
not_default: fastembed installed (without it the vectors fall back to a hash)
